desc: Experience the evolution of accuracy with the X-Bolt 2 Hells Canyon McMillan LR Suppressor Ready. This big game hunting rifle features a composite McMillan Game Scout stock with Browning OVIX Camo finish and Pachmayr Decelerator recoil pad; redesigned receiver and bolt; fluted heavy sporter weight barrel with Recoil Hawg muzzle brake; aluminum 20 MOA Picatinny optics rail; X-Lock Scope Mounting System; Plus Magazine System and durable Cerakote finish.
